row.evidence: Sourcegraph sells a single Enterprise plan ('Starting at $16K Minimum annual contract'), and its docs say 'Sourcegraph supports SCIM 2.0 for provisioning and de-provisioning users.'
row.notes: New row. The pricing page lists only one plan, Enterprise, starting at a $16K minimum annual contract (Contact sales, single-tenant cloud or self-hosted), so SCIM sits on the only paid plan with no upcharge (rule 1a: single paid plan). Reviewers may prefer gated since that plan is Enterprise/contact-sales only. Per-user price is not published, so per-user fields are null. SCIM 2.0 (beta) is Users-only, at {instance}/.api/scim/v2/ with a static bearer token set in site config; tested only with Okta and Microsoft Entra ID; one SCIM client at a time; no bulk, sorting or ETags. Requires an existing IdP auth provider (SAML/OIDC). The SAML page still says 'Work is planned to support SCIM on SAML auth providers' (stale, see conflicts). No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app found (both 404), so IdPs use the generic endpoint. User management otherwise via the GraphQL debug API (deleteUser soft or hard delete).

auth.token_source: Admin-generated random token (max 255 chars) set as scim.authToken in site configuration

deprovision.notes: Okta is set to 'Deactivate Users' and DELETE is supported, but the docs do not say what Sourcegraph does on deactivation. Admin 'Delete' soft-deletes the user and all associated data.

limitations.text: SCIM is in beta and only validated with Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.
No bulk operations, sorting or ETags; only one SCIM client can be configured at a time.
Users only: the User endpoint syncs only username, name and email addresses.

auth.notes: Access tokens (personal or service account) or OAuth access tokens.

endpoints.purpose: GraphQL debug API; admin mutations include updateUser and deleteUser (soft, or hard: true)

audit_log_api.notes: Audit events are emitted to structured logs (docs/admin/audit-log), not a query API.

limitations.text: The GraphQL API is a debug API with no backwards-compatibility guarantees.

okta.notes: Custom SAML 2.0 app integration with SCIM provisioning per Sourcegraph's guide; okta.com/integrations/sourcegraph/ returns 404.

entra.notes: Generic SCIM with scim.identityProvider set to 'Azure AD'; Entra gallery tutorials return 404.

fallbacks.notes: SAML allowSignup defaults to true (accounts created on first sign-in); OIDC and other providers also exist.
